ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 40% high-intensity white pixels localized at the distal tips and 60% low-intensity black pixels localized at the medial and central regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white distal lobes with irregular, diffuse black mottling and stippling along the interior margins. Central fluke area is a solid low-intensity black contiguous region extending from the peduncle to the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with an estimated angle of 75 degrees and a high depth-to-width ratio relative to the lobe span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the distal third of both lobes; transition to smoother, low-frequency wave patterns toward the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly concave curvature extending from the median notch to the lateral tips, resulting in a swept-back appearance.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-intensity white circular pixels consistent with barnacle colonization on the extreme lateral edges and tips of both fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple high-contrast, non-parallel linear streaks (rake marks) detected primarily on the dark medial surfaces of the right lobe, oriented diagonally relative to the peduncle axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of extensive barnacle clusters on distal tips and numerous linear rake marks across the central pigmented regions.
other_distinctive_markers: Irregular jagged deformation on the trailing edge of the left lobe approximately mid-way between the notch and tip, distinct from standard serrations.
